captions.detailed: This 3D model features an internally routed dropper seatpost topped with a streamlined black bicycle saddle. The assembly includes a lower outer sleeve with a bottom cable routing pivot, a telescoping inner post capped by a guide collar, and a dual-bolt rail clamp cradle holding the saddle's metallic rails. The saddle itself has a flat, low-profile design with a shortened nose and firm black padding, while the post and clamp mechanisms are rendered in a matte black finish.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an internally routed dropper seatpost with an integrated bicycle saddle. The model should feature a lower outer sleeve with a bottom pivot, a telescoping inner post that moves along the vertical axis, and a dual-bolt rail cradle clamp holding a low-profile, flat-nosed black saddle.
captions.factory: Construct the outer dropper sleeve and telescoping inner post using concentric cylinders, modeling the bottom routing pivot with small box and cylinder additions. Build the top collar and the rail clamp cradle using extruded profiles, adding cylinders for the mounting bolts and rails. Model the saddle by lofting or extruding a contoured flat profile with rounded edges, then assemble all parts using a prismatic joint to allow linear telescoping motion of the inner post.
